name: ultiwrite-forensics
description: Document forensics. Metadata analysis. No permanent document retention.

interface.longDescription: Examine an original PDF, Office file, RTF, image, or supported ZIP for construction, typography, layout, metadata and retained editing evidence. Each completed examination returns source-bound findings, a Document Forensics Report PDF, a separate Metadata Analytics Report PDF, a structured export, and an artifact manifest. No permanent document retention: your files are processed temporarily and automatically deleted; there is no permanent archive of your documents or reports. Findings are evidence to assess, not an authenticity certificate.

positive.prompt: Which Ultiwrite Forensics account am I connected to and how many analyses do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the connected account (email for email sign-in), available and reserved units and granted permissions. No analysis is started.

positive.prompt: What file types can Ultiwrite Forensics examine and how long are reports kept?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists accepted formats, the 48 MiB attachment/browser limit, the 3 MiB inline limit and the 40-page PDF limit, whether examinations are available, and the temporary-processing retention windows (source deleted within one hour, report available up to 24 hours).

positive.prompt: Check this bank statement PDF for signs of editing.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses only a host-provided downloadable attachment or exact original bytes. If attachment access is unavailable, returns the signed first-party upload handoff and resumes after upload. Starts exactly one authorized examination, polls status, and reuses its request key after a network interruption without a second charge.

positive.prompt: What did the examination find, and what does the document metadata show?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns findings with ids, severities, explanations and evidence references; document metadata; completed versus unassessed checks; examiner status and limitations. States that findings are not an authenticity verdict.

positive.prompt: Give me the forensic PDF, the metadata analytics PDF, and the zip of all deliverables.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Document Forensics Report PDF, and can return the Metadata Analytics Report, the structured export, the manifest, and a zip of those files. Each download includes its SHA-256 and a signed-in web link. Repeated downloads match those hashes. Reports are deleted 24 hours after creation.

negative.description: General business investigation is out of scope
negative.prompt: Investigate the owners of Synthetic Holdings LLC and their other companies.

negative.description: Arbitrary registry searches and authenticity certification are not offered
negative.prompt: Look up this EIN directly in the IRS database and confirm it is valid.
Certify that this contract is authentic so I can show the bank.
